title: Find and Replace (:%s/old/new/g)
instruction_text:
Replace text throughout the entire file!

':%s/old/new/g' = replace all 'old' with 'new'
':%s/old/new/gc' = replace with confirmation
':s/old/new/g' = replace on current line only
':%s/old/new/' = replace first occurrence per line

Your task: Replace all occurrences of 'cat' with 'dog'.

Steps:
1. Press ':' to enter command mode
2. Type '%s/cat/dog/g'
3. Press ENTER
4. All 'cat' should change to 'dog'
5. Save with :wq

This is one of Vim's most powerful features!
setup_file:
The cat sat on the mat.
Another cat walked by.
A third cat appeared.
cat cat cat
target_content:
The dog sat on the mat.
Another dog walked by.
A third dog appeared.
dog dog dog
